Aleksandr Bibikov Aleksandr Ilyich Bibikov (Moscow – , Bugulma) was a Russian statesman and military officer. Bibikov came from an old noble family; Field Marshal Mikhail Kutuzov was his brother-in-law. He began his military service in 1746, participating in the Seven Years' War (1756–1763). He was unit commander in the Battle of Zorndorf. His unit lost 60 officers and about half of soldiers but did not retreat. He was promoted to Colonel Rank by Empress Elizabeth of Russia. He also participated in Battle of Kunersdorf and thereafter was appointed military commandant of Frankfurt. Bibikov acted against the Polish Bar Confederation (1771–1774).
